notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped Send Interaction With Regions and timestamped Receive Interaction surfaces to the official C++ declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. The Catch2 scenarios cover committed region overlap, a disjoint-region no-fanout designator, lower-bound validation, constrained-recipient queueing before the grant, sent-region callback propagation, timestamp/order/retraction fields, pending-fanout suppression, and a legal Request Retraction callback for an already-delivered nonconstrained overlap-qualified recipient. The shared recipient planner ignores passive regional pairs and routes only active overlap-qualified pairs; the current timestamped cases do not independently exercise a passive pair. Object-region services, relaxed DDM, alternate advance modes, save/restore, remote transport, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
